sources.evidenceRaw: The University of Paderborn and Karlsruhe Institute of Technology describe INGRID as a research database with more than 100,000 digitized and annotated graffiti photographs. The project offers a free research login and a public knowledge graph/RDF dump. The public dataset includes a subset of photographs from private collector Peter Kreuzer; police-provided Mannheim, Munich and Cologne photographs are not publicly visible in the dump. The public image archive is published separately.
sources.institution: Universität Paderborn / Karlsruher Institut für Technologie (INGRID)
sources.nextActionRaw: Query the public RDF/knowledge graph for records from the Peter Kreuzer collection, filter to readable short item strings and clear public image links, then inspect item-level images directly. Prefer persistent resource URIs and original system IDs over manual reproductions.
sources.rightsRaw: Public graffiti photographs in the INGRID dataset are CC BY-SA 4.0; generated metadata is CC0 and INGRIDKG is CC BY 4.0. Only a subset of photographs is public (not police-provided Mannheim/Munich/Cologne images); verify the collection and item-level record before use. NIGHTSHIFT remains link-only and does not copy, embed or trace images.
